causes.text: On 27 July 2023 Meta reported that its Reels short-video product was closing the revenue gap with TikTok. The company said AI-powered recommendation algorithms were serving more than 200 billion Reels plays per day and that the product's annual revenue run rate had jumped to about $10 billion, showing advertisers were embracing the format.

source_info.title: Meta's Reels revenue narrows gap with TikTok as AI boosts engagement

causes.text: Meta released the commercial version of its Llama 2 language model on 18 July 2023. The company offered the powerful large-language model free for business use and partnered with Microsoft Azure to distribute it, positioning the open-source model as an alternative to proprietary AI systems from rivals.

source_info.title: Meta opens Llama 2 AI model to commercial use, gets support from Microsoft

effects.text: On 2 February 2024 Meta's stock price surged about 20.3 percent after the company posted strong quarterly results, issued its first dividend and projected continued robust advertising growth. The rally added roughly $196 billion to Meta's market value, the largest one-day gain ever achieved by a U.S. company.

source_info.title: Meta surges with record $196 billion gain in stock market value after dividend and strong results

causal_reasoning_chain.description: Meta's improved Reels product leveraged advanced AI recommendation algorithms to drive more than 200 billion daily plays and a revenue run rate approaching $10 billion. Advertisers were drawn to the high engagement levels, signalling that the company had found a successful response to TikTok's short-video dominance.

In parallel, Meta released Llama 2 as an open-source large language model and allowed free commercial use. The decision showcased Meta's technological prowess, attracted developers and businesses, and increased goodwill toward the company's AI strategy.

These initiatives collectively boosted Meta's advertising business and burnished its reputation as a leader in AI. By late 2023 and early 2024, the company's revenue growth re-accelerated and investor confidence improved ahead of earnings season.

When Meta reported fourth-quarter results on 2 February 2024, it beat analysts' estimates, introduced its first dividend and signalled continued momentum. The market responded enthusiastically: Meta's share price leapt roughly 20.3 percent, adding about $196 billion in value-the largest single-day gain ever recorded by a U.S. company; on 2024-02-02 shares were up about 20.30% versus the prior trading day.

rationale: By strengthening its core Reels advertising product and demonstrating AI leadership with Llama 2, Meta laid the groundwork for a blowout earnings report. The combination of improved business performance and investor optimism produced a historic stock-price surge.
counterfactual_analysis: If Reels had not gained traction or Llama 2 had failed to impress developers, Meta might not have delivered such strong results, and the stock rally on 2 February 2024 could have been muted.

adversarial_confounders.text: Broader market enthusiasm for technology stocks and easing macroeconomic concerns might also have contributed to the magnitude of Meta's rally.
adversarial_confounders.impact: Positive market sentiment could inflate the effect attributed to Meta's product and AI initiatives alone.

details.commentary: By mid 2023 Meta had shown that Reels could generate meaningful ad revenue and that Llama 2 could attract developers and enterprise interest, strengthening its position against TikTok and rival AI platforms. Those successes reduced fears that competitors would erode Meta's moat, setting the stage for investors to reward the company with a record share price jump when strong results confirmed the strategy was working.

details.pestel_factor: Technological - Advancements in AI recommendation and open-source models
details.commentary: Advances in AI recommendation systems and open models were reshaping how social networks, advertisers and developers interacted. Meta's ability to harness these technological trends in both consumer products and developer tools convinced the market that it could sustain high growth in a changing environment, helping to justify the huge one day gain.

Strong AI driven engagement and ad performance feed into higher revenue and cash flow, which then fund more AI and infrastructure investment, further improving products. The record stock move in February 2024 reflects investors recognising this reinforcing loop and updating their expectations for how powerful it could be over the next few years.
